name: Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU)
analyst_actions: 2026-09-04 | Bank of America Securities | reiterates Hold | 205->205
product: Enrichment: separative work units (SWU) and enriched uranium, i.e. LEU for the existing reactor fleet and HALEU for advanced SMR and microreactors, plus national-security enrichment. Customers include utilities, X-energy, Radiant, Antares and DOE (2026-08-05 and 2026-09-17 filings).
demand: Mix and price, not SWU volume. Q2 2026 SWU volume fell 23 percent and price rose only 3 percent; SWU revenue fell to 100.0M USD from 125.7M USD. LEU revenue rose 22 percent because uranium sales of 53.4M USD, a new revenue line, were added - a mix shift (2026-08-05).
pricing_power: Already visible: Q2 2026 GAAP net income fell 42 percent y/y on 17.2M USD extra stock comp and 7.5M USD advanced-technology costs, with SWU unit cost up 13 percent. Loss of DOE HALEU cascade funding (about 0.8B USD Technical Solutions backlog) plus heavy warrant dilution would compound it (2026-08-05).
competition: Russian and Chinese enrichment, Rosatom with TENEX and CNNC, is the low-cost substitute; continued Russian LEU availability is a stated guidance assumption. Chinese HALEU or enrichment at scale is not yet a direct substitute; Urenco and Orano are higher-cost Western alternatives (2026-08-05).
market_strategy: CEO Amir Vexler, 2026-08-05: the first new centrifuge will be completed in Oak Ridge Tennessee before the end of the year, with 2026 guidance to finalize all critical build-out contracts, hire at least 175 net new Piketon employees, and release a Certified for Construction package. 2026-09-17: the expansion is now well underway.
bull: Definitive HALEU contracts with X-energy (2026-08-06), Radiant (2026-09-09) and Antares (2026-09-17), sole licensed Western HALEU plant, 4.5B USD backlog, and S&P SmallCap 600 inclusion (2026-07-14) show real demand and delivery.
bear: Q2 2026 GAAP net income fell 42% y/y, SWU volume -23%, gross margin -12.7pp, DOE FY2027 budget omits ~0.8B USD HALEU cascade funding, and the 2026-09-09 offering adds ~48% potential share growth via warrants.
falsifier: First new Oak Ridge centrifuge not completed by 2026-12-31, management's own deadline (2026-08-05 8-K outlook).
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30d: 2026-09-17 Antares HALEU supply contract; 2026-09-09 Radiant HALEU contract; 2026-09-11 8-K disclosed talks to buy a domestic supplier for about 115-125M USD; 2026-09-09 priced a 500M USD stock-and-warrant offering. Last 90d: 2026-08-05 Q2 revenue 176.1M USD and backlog 4.5B USD; 2026-08-06 X-energy LEU and HALEU deal; 2026-07-14 joined S&P SmallCap 600.
web_true_now_not_modelled: Dilution not yet modelled: the 2026-09-11 offering adds 500000 shares plus pre-funded warrants for 2005513 and common warrants for 6992382 shares at strikes 226.86 to 362.98 USD, about 48 percent potential share growth. Also 2026-08-05: DOE FY2027 budget omits HALEU cascade funding covering about 0.8B USD of backlog; Q2 GAAP net income fell 42 percent y/y.
web_demand_product: Enrichment: separative work units (SWU) and enriched uranium, i.e. LEU for the existing reactor fleet and HALEU for advanced SMR and microreactors, plus national-security enrichment. Customers include utilities, X-energy, Radiant, Antares and DOE (2026-08-05 and 2026-09-17 filings).
web_price_volume_mix: Mix and price, not SWU volume. Q2 2026 SWU volume fell 23 percent and price rose only 3 percent; SWU revenue fell to 100.0M USD from 125.7M USD. LEU revenue rose 22 percent because uranium sales of 53.4M USD, a new revenue line, were added - a mix shift (2026-08-05).
web_bottleneck: Centrifuge manufacturing and HALEU enrichment capacity. Centrus operates the only licensed HALEU production facility in the Western world, the American Centrifuge Plant at Piketon Ohio, and is scaling at Oak Ridge Tennessee; that capacity, not demand, is the constraint it relieves for the West (2026-09-17).
web_who_benefits_next: Advanced-reactor and microreactor developers (X-energy, Radiant, Antares) secure HALEU; U.S. utilities and defense programs (Army Janus, Air Force, Space Force) get domestic fuel; build-out suppliers benefit, such as Geiger Brothers construction contractor and the undisclosed domestic manufacturing acquisition target (2026-08-05, 2026-09-11).
web_who_loses: Russian enrichers TENEX and Rosatom lose Western market share as U.S. enrichment returns; rival Western enrichers Urenco and Orano lose share and pricing power; existing Centrus shareholders are diluted by the large warrant overhang from the 2026-09-11 offering.
web_margin_collapse_risk: Already visible: Q2 2026 GAAP net income fell 42 percent y/y on 17.2M USD extra stock comp and 7.5M USD advanced-technology costs, with SWU unit cost up 13 percent. Loss of DOE HALEU cascade funding (about 0.8B USD Technical Solutions backlog) plus heavy warrant dilution would compound it (2026-08-05).
web_low_cost_substitute: Russian and Chinese enrichment, Rosatom with TENEX and CNNC, is the low-cost substitute; continued Russian LEU availability is a stated guidance assumption. Chinese HALEU or enrichment at scale is not yet a direct substitute; Urenco and Orano are higher-cost Western alternatives (2026-08-05).
web_ceo_promised: CEO Amir Vexler, 2026-08-05: the first new centrifuge will be completed in Oak Ridge Tennessee before the end of the year, with 2026 guidance to finalize all critical build-out contracts, hire at least 175 net new Piketon employees, and release a Certified for Construction package. 2026-09-17: the expansion is now well underway.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes on contracts: S&P SmallCap 600 inclusion effective 2026-07-14 (announced 2026-07-07); the 900M USD DOE HALEU task order was finalized (2026-07-07); HALEU deals signed with X-energy (2026-08-06), Radiant (2026-09-09) and Antares (2026-09-17). Not yet delivered: the first Oak Ridge centrifuge, still due by 2026-12-31.
web_what_would_falsify: First new Oak Ridge centrifuge not completed by 2026-12-31, management's own deadline; a final DOE FY2027 appropriation omitting HALEU cascade operation funding, removing about 0.8B USD of Technical Solutions backlog; or collapse of the 2026-09-11 disclosed 115-125M USD domestic-supplier acquisition talks.
